items.title: Translate a request for help
items.instructions: Translate the Vietnamese sentence into polite, simple English.

payload.source_text: Làm ơn giúp tôi tìm Cổng 3.
payload.intended_meaning: A polite request for assistance locating Gate 3.
acceptable_variants: Could you help me find Gate 3?
payload.scoring_guidance: Require a polite request, help, and Gate 3.

items.title: Read why Nam ran
items.instructions: Read the short text and answer both questions.

payload.stimulus: Nam missed the first bell, so he ran across the school yard. He reached his classroom before the lesson began.

answers.answer: Because he missed the first bell.

items.title: Complete a finished action
items.instructions: Use the past form of run to complete the sentence.

payload.stimulus: Yesterday, I ___ to catch the bus.
payload.explanation: Yesterday marks a completed past action, and the past form of run is ran.

items.title: Build a useful request
items.instructions: Use all the words to make a polite request.

payload.primary_answer: Please help me read this sign.
acceptable_variants: Please help me read this sign.
payload.scoring_guidance: Require every word and a grammatically complete polite request.

items.title: Listen for event and need
items.instructions: Use the transcript as a listening script and answer the questions.

payload.transcript: Tuan says, ‘I ran to the bus stop, but I dropped my map. Please help me find Platform 1.’

answers.answer: He ran to the bus stop.
